services.name: Admission
services.desc: ​Click on the graphics below to explore the different aspects of the West Parry Sound District's history! Did you know that roughly 20,000 people from all over the world visit the Tower Hill observation tower every year? Although this amazing place has always been a great tourist attraction, its history proves that it is much more than that! Learn more about this popular Parry Sound location in our newest virtual exhibition. The logging industry in Ontario began around 1860, with American lumber companies moving north to expand their markets after removing much of the timber along the lake states.
